fusions.name: Banked Coal
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Stir the Cinders
fusions.desc: Breathes a bolt that deals 16 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, with 60% more damage for each one used up.

fusions.name: Raked Ember Line
fusions.desc: Lays a line of fire 5 tiles long in front of you for 10 seconds. It deals 4 fire damage to anything that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Not Quite Out
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, a bolt of fire strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 7 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
